knob_doc_excerpt: pyfftw two-buffer ping-pong on/off (true shipped). off halves the resident workspace for one array copy per fft. the transform's values are byte-identical either way; the object handed back is a live workspace view in one mode and a private copy in the other, which numpy's temporary elision can distinguish. changing it clears the plan cache.
